Markdown.Toolbar.ViewModeTip: What to show: the rendered document, both side by side, or the raw markdown source
Markdown.Error.SaveFailedFormat: The document could not be saved: {0}
Markdown.Error.PictureSaveFailedFormat: Could not save the picture to {0}: {1}
Markdown.Toolbar.Summarize.Tip: Summarise the whole document, section by section, with this workspace's Documents model. The summary opens beside it, a heading per section leading back to it.
Markdown.Toolbar.Translate.Tip: Translate the whole document into another language with this workspace's Documents model, keeping its markup, code and diagrams as they are. The translation opens beside it.
Markdown.DocumentWork.NotADocumentFormat: {0} is not a Markdown document. Summarise and Translate work on a Markdown file or a Markdown Package.
Markdown.DocumentWork.SaveFirst: Save it first: what is made leads back to the document where it is saved.
